notes.title: Psychopomp Gold is now available in Spanish! + More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's been a little bit! Here's an update for Psychopomp Gold, bringing some new features and bug fixes!

First and Foremost:
[h2]Psychopomp is Now Available in Spanish![/h2]
It's been a while coming, but Psychopomp Gold is now finally available in Spanish! Special thanks to our lovely translator, Cygazzi! Without them, this wouldn't have been possible!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226812/7a3c67fb27a552309e62fac68aadb6715684ad8d.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226812/ae2ed5c7caf787c78b5fbf6bc15604a921ca5cf4.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226812/519e9ccf6b648fd20a64d335e08bb12e0cec0b5b.png[/img]
As you can see here, all of your beloved and classic Psychopomp Gold moments are now in Spanish!
I hope you'll enjoy!

There's more to this update, including some long awaited bugfixes, tweaks, changes and other cool stuff!

Changes:
[list]
[*]Piss Lipid Boy now bleeds piss rather than blood
[*]Scythe Teleporter in symbols has been moved to a more forgiving position
[*]Updated some credits
[*]Cursor now changes to a crosshair when using the hammer, to make it more clear that you must click [i]on[/i] a monster's body to hit them
[*]Removed incorrect Machine sounds in the desert
[*]Extra hidden stuff, perhaps?
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed Crackling Audio on some sound systems
[*]Fixed some broken Distance Fog in the Mariana Trench
[*]Multiple Fixes to OpenGL renderer: It's still not recommended, but it should be less horribly broken.
[*]Fixed a few numerical errors leading to some rare crashes
[/list]

I'll be watching for bugs and other stuff, a major amount of baseline code was changed in this update, so bugs are not out of the question. If you run into any issues with this update, please let me know in the comments, and I'll look to fix them as soon as possible!

I hope you all have a wonderful day, and a fun night too!

Thanks!
-Karbonic

notes.title: Psychopomp Merch is Back in Stock!!
notes.notes:
First, I'd like to thank you for the support on the first wave of merch, we ran out of stock almost immediately, and a lot of people felt left out on things like mousepads and other stuff. So, we've got more and we're ready to go! 

[url=https://fadingclubstore.com/]You can check it out at FadingClubStore.com!
[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226812/20ecb141cabf28c1bd7de33d7257023fa6d7d40a.gif[/img]

[i](Important Note on International)
I have spent time researching possible ways to get this merch out to international customers.
Unfortunately, due to current situations, customers would be paying Cost + Shipping + Customs + Tax + Tariffs, and I just can't justify that. In some countries, the costs were so high that customers would have to pay easily over 200% of the cost of the product, which is insane.

I will still look in the future to bring merch to international fans, I really want to get these things out there, but I also want them to be fairly priced, and I don't want to force customers to pay such exorbitant fees. I appreciate your patience in this situation.[/i]

I thank you all for the support, and I hope that you'll enjoy the cool stuff I have planned for the future! I've got some neat game stuff in the works that I can't wait to show off! 
Thank you all!
-Karbonic

notes.title: Workshop Support for Psychopomp Gold!
notes.notes:
Hello!
I'm happy to announce that Psychopomp Gold now has Workshop support!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3243190/workshop/]Check out the workshop here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226812/8ea2d7327c27070e3bf0b7e84a601134d2dd7612.png[/img]

This workshop is a place where you can upload and easily download mods, custom maps, and more!
I can't wait to see what people make!

[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SSx4i98AMXY_YRPqJhup779WXdnwuR1z/view?usp=sharing]If you'd like to create a mod for Psychopomp Gold, check out the SDK here![/url]
Be sure to read Readme.txt for a quick tutorial on creating mods.
I will be creating a more in depth video tutorial on the tools soon.

Some other changes have been made to Psychopomp Gold.

Changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed problem where certain localizations were not appearing
[*]Fixed a bunch of places where the player could walk into walls
[*]Fixed missing attack animation on Anime Stalk creature
[*]Added look support on Controller, you can now look around with the right stick
[*]Added cutscene skipping on Controller
[/list]

Future changes to be fixed:
These are things I'd like to change soon.
To Do:
[list]
[*]Fix audio crackling on some PCs, this is caused by a problem in Godot's audio codec
[*]Fix problem with shadows on Opengl version, this is caused by a bug in Godot 4.2
[*]Update game to Godot 4.3 (this will take some time, a lot of code will need to be updated to fit)
[/list]

I hope you are all having a good day!
-Karbonic

notes.title: Psychopomp Gold 10/27/21 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello! We've got another group of fixes and changes! I hope you're having fun with the game!

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Abridged ending area of DNA Instructions Area, removing unnecessary catwalks which added to walking time

[*]Added Gates to DNA Instructions Area so that players will not get lost before they find out what the goal of the area is
[*]Added new achievements for Ephemeral and Aberrant Locations
[*]Added new achievements for not healing and not attacking in a level
[*]Fixed place in Home area where the player could get their foot stuck in trash forever
[*]Fixed bug on controller where interaction buttons would behave erratically if the player was moving
[*]Fixed bug on controller where mouse cursor would flicker on screen when selecting something
[*]Fixed localization issue where Russian title wasn't shown on final tease
[*]Fixed issue in Home area where the player could rub their face into the wall to progress
[*]Increased stamina refill speed
[/list]

I hope you all have a great day, and I appreciate all of the support!
If you have any feedback, suggestions, or bugs to report, feel free to let me know in the comments!

Thanks,
[i]-Karbonic[/i]
